prediction.model: LightGBM on physics features + Sightglass rationale engine
prediction.rationale:
Cooler: full efficiency. Evidence: TS1 temperature slope 0.408 °C/min (3% above healthy); TS3 mean temperature 38.7 °C (within 1% of healthy). Operating temperatures and thermal gradient remain within optimal baseline specifications.
Valve: close to total failure. Evidence: PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 9.99 s (within 2% of healthy); PS2 pressure rise time 9.69 s (4% above healthy). Substantial delay in circuit pressurization confirms delayed spool actuation in the main valve.
Pump leakage: weak leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 6.46 l/min (within 2% of healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 395 W·min/l (3% above healthy); SE system efficiency factor 56.1 % (4% below healthy). Minor drop in delivered flow relative to motor power indicates early internal pump leakage.
Accumulator: close to total failure. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 47.6 bar (2% above healthy). Dampening capacity is substantially impaired, producing high-frequency pressure oscillations across the circuit.

tslm_prediction.rationale:
Cooler: full efficiency. Evidence: TS1 temperature slope 0.41 °C/min (4% above healthy); TS4 mean temperature 30.6 °C (within 1% of healthy). Operating temperatures and thermal gradient remain within optimal baseline specifications.
Valve: close to total failure. Evidence: PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 10.0 s (2% above healthy); PS2 pressure rise time 9.69 s (4% above healthy). Transient response is severely sluggish, preventing timely transition of working pressure.
Pump leakage: weak leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 6.47 l/min (within 2% of healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 394 W·min/l (3% above healthy); SE system efficiency factor 56.0 % (4% below healthy). Volumetric delivery is slightly compromised due to minor internal bypass flow.
Accumulator: severely reduced. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 47.5 bar (2% above healthy). Pressure buffering is largely ineffective due to compromised pre-charge pressure in the accumulator.
